Name: The Robin Romance Mod - Anime Portrait
Author: FoulTarnishedAsh
Description:
Replace Robin's Portrait for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3239]The Robin Romance Mod[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi's anime portraits[/url] as source.
Yes I know there's already another mod for this, but that mod hasn't been updated since 2019 and it doesn't support the 4 new variants.
I didn't really do much work since I only edited and added a few variants on ohodavi's mod.
I [i]might[/i] going to add the winter version too in the future if I figured out how to do it.

[b]Installation[/b]:
Extract the Ram.png and copy it to [i]/Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] Robin Romance/[CP] Robin Romance w Veronica/Assets/Portraits[/i], overwrite the original file(I suggest you to make a backup for the original files).
